programme.title: Hey Arnold!

programme.desc: Casa Paradiso/Gerald''s Tonsils: Grandpa becomes tired of dealing with the boarding house and decides to sell./Gerald has his tonsils removed before a big concert and must come to grips with the fact that his voice has changed.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP14 Crystal Mother [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito and Aoko are on a luxury train with the Queen of Ingram, her son, and the Principality of Ingram's Crystal Mother, a huge topaz that may contain the Pandora jewel. The queen has the real jewel cleverly hidden, though, making it a challenge for Kaito/Kid to find it before the train reaches Osaka. On top of that, he's got competition, as there's a Snake on the train!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP15 The Princess and the Thief's Improv [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP16 Kid vs. Conan: Miraculous Airwalking [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief literally rises to the occasion when old man Jirokichi of the Suzuki conglomerate throws down the gauntlet. But with Detective Conan as part of the security team guarding the Blue Wonder jewel, will Kaito finally get his wings clipped?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP17 Green Dream [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP18 Golden Eye (Part One): Chat Noir's Challenge [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid has a new phantom thief rival in town, who flew all the way from France: Chat Noir! The felonious feline challenges Kid to steal a cat's-eye ring which may have belonged to Marie Antoinette, but this time, tough security measures have also been imported from France.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP19 Golden Eye (Part Two): Kid Versus Chat Noir: Endgame [English Dub]
programme.desc: Right on schedule, Kid the Phantom Thief makes his move to steal Marie Antoinette's cat's-eye ring off the hand of Inspector Nakamori... but has the French cat burglar Chat Noir already made the first move? And will either one of them be able to escape the "inescapable cage"?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP20 Dark Knight [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid is pressured into teaming up with Nightmare, a masked criminal mastermind with a penchant for losing partners to police custody and sometimes death itself! Will Kid make a successful steal and survive the night?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP21 Kid Versus Conan: Teleportation Under the Moonlight [English Dub]

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP22 Red Tear [English Dub]

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]

programme.desc: Corbeau the Phantom Thief, a black-clad, dead-ringer for Kid's father, appears and challenges him. Kaito agrees, but if he fails, he'll have to retire as a phantom thief!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: While trying to retrieve the 7th Chaos Emerald from Dr. Eggman, Sonic and Friends are transported to the human world where Sonic is rescued by a boy named Chris.

programme.title: Sonic X

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Eggman tries to use E-23 to take over the world Amy, Knuckles and Tails launch an unsuccessful counterattack, until Sonic arrives! And with a ring from Tails, Sonic destroys E-23 and saves Amy with the help of Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chris' teacher has been replaced with the President's spy, Mr. Stewart. Meanwhile, the first Chaos Emerald appears at a construction site. It's then a race to the stone between Eggman and Sonic!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman tricks Knuckles into blaming Sonic for being stuck in the human world, Knuckles challenges Sonic to a duel! But Knuckles realizes he's being duped and teams up with Sonic to destroy the robot and save the others.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP80 The Last Gift in Prison is Cup Ramen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Silver, who once worked with Lupin on a train robbery, stole the money himself, hid it somewhere, and promptly got himself thrown into prison on a rinky-dink charge. Lupin, having learned that Silver is about to be released, goes to the prison intent on making Silver tell what he did with the loot, only to discover that, while Silver was in prison, a new top-of-the-line prison was built over the site where he hid the money. Now, will the operation to trade an execution for the recovery of the money succeed?!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP81 Fujiko, Men are A Sorry Lot! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Lupin is after the Golden Bell, symbol of the monarchy of Beltenberg and precious tourist attraction. However, the bell that sparkles in the belfry is just a brass replica. Though Fujiko insists that the bell made of gold doesn't exist, Lupin believes to the contrary. Meanwhile, Lupin gets news of Fujiko's engagement to prince Claude of Beltenberg, whom she had met in Paris.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP82 Hostage Rescue Operation: Pops [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Zenigata is taken hostage from ICPO headquarters. The terrorists demand to swap him with their boss Napoleon XI, but ICPO refuses. Since Zenigata is no further use to them, the terrorists are bound to kill him; Lupin must now come to his rescue but do it delicately so as to not hurt Zenigata's pride. Thus, begins Lupin's Zenigata-rescue caper ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP83 Lupin’s Big Western [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Smith Gang hit-man company was once the best in the business, but they're suffering now from tough competition. Though the company chairman Smith considers running TV ads to revive his business, he can't think of a good way to do it. Fujiko gets word that he's willing to shovel out 300 million dollars for a good idea, so they decide to film a Western in which Lupin gets killed ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP84 Leave the Revenge to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Though Joe Spade was once a formidable hitman of renown and Jigen's sharpshooter coach, he now comes to beg for Jigen's help; he had gotten old, flubbed a hit contract, and is now on the run. Jigen decides to help his old mentor and heads to Mareseilles with Lupin, but Lupin has a change of heart because he hates killers. So Jigen heads to Jigen's ramshakle shack all by himself ...

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 19

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 4

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 6

programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.1
programme.desc: What's not to love about Xishuangbanna? From dazzling night markets to lush bamboo forests, 800-year old tea trees to close encounters with elephants, this tropical city in southwest China has everything, and is where the story of tea begins. Join Foodwise for all the Pu'er tea you can drink and feast on everything from banana flowers to "elephant food"!

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.2
programme.desc: Come get soaked at the Dai people's New Year celebrations! We'll check out buzzing street markets packed with barbecued meats and spicy fruits, crash a foodie auction, and even take part in a rowdy competition, catching fish with our bare hands in the river. All this before hiking through an actual rainforest. We're going to need all the good tea and food we can get!

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon".

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.8
programme.desc: Hunan, in south-central China, is cradled by mountains on three sides. With rolling hills and cross-crossing rivers flowing into Dongting Lake and the Yangtze, this is a land that has given breath to a culture of diligence and endeavor that has expressed itself as eloquently on the province's fields and terraces as it has in the books produced by its many scholars and poets...

programme.title: Culture Forward
programme.desc: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from "word candy" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.9
programme.desc: Hebei is, in a sense, a sort of geographic compendium of the whole of China. With the Yan Mountains demarcate plateaus from plains, they also stand guard over the strategic corridor linking the northeast to the country's heartland.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.sub-title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.sub-title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from "word candy" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.9
programme.desc: Hebei is, in a sense, a sort of geographic compendium of the whole of China. With the Yan Mountains demarcate plateaus from plains, they also stand guard over the strategic corridor linking the northeast to the country's heartland.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.sub-title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. programme.title: Race to the Rock
programme.desc: The Race to the Rock is an annual unsupported ultra-distance bicycle race through the Australian Outback organized by Jesse Carlsson. Unlike stage races, such as the Tour De France, ultra-distance races start and run continuously until the competitors finish the race, forcing them to make such strategic choices as whether it would be better to take time to eat or sleep, or to sacrifice those things and press on. Race to the Rock is an unsupported race, which means that racers are not permitted to draft or to obtain help from anything other than publicly available sources that are available for all. The course varies every year, but finishes at Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock, and has been so gruelling that only a very small percentage of the competitors have ever finished the race. Roads are mostly unsealed, with limited water supplies, and stretches of 400-500 kilometres at times with no food resupply available.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Luke Woodham v Adam Elder"
programme.desc: Drievoudig Gymkhana Grid-kampioen Luke Woodham verdedigt zijn titel. Zijn grootste tegenstander, Adam Elder, doet alles wat in zijn macht ligt om te winnen.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Great 8"
programme.desc: De weg naar Gymkhana Grid: 100% pure adrenaline! Acht topcoureurs van de sport worden in kaart gebracht, we lezen hun gedachten en we zien de mentale voorbereiding die zij nodig hebben om mee te doen.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 300"
programme.desc: Voor de restauratie van een ultrazeldzame 1957 Mercedes Benz 300 SL Roadster wordt een moderne Mercedes Benz SLK 230 als donorvoertuig ingezet.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Eleven"
programme.desc: Nik explores the Mazda CX30 Turbo and Toyota 4Runner. He highlights the 2022 VW IDA and off-roads in the Hyundai Santa Cruz. Hopes are high for the Lexus LF-Z Concept Electric.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Twelve"
programme.desc: Nik praises the 2021 Lincoln Aviator GT Hybrid. Mike showcases the 2021 Audi Q5. Nik explains Jeep's luxury transformation of the Wagoneer. He tests the hands-free drive of the 2022 Chevy Bolt SUV.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "1978 Trans Am"
programme.desc: De zwarte Trans Am uit 1978 heeft een gloednieuwe motor en is klaar om voor het eerst gestart te worden. De “Malicious Intent”, een Mustang uit 1969, is klaar voor de spuiterij. De restauratie van de Corvette uit 1972 – van lelijk naar prachtig – zit nu in de stripproces.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "Mecum Auctions, Houston, Texas"
programme.desc: Vinnie en Jan bezoeken Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas, waar ze een paar van de gaafste klassieke musclecars bekijken die binnenkort geveild worden.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "Malicious Intent"
programme.desc: Vinnie en het team van Muscle Cars of Texas werken in de spuitcabine aan de “Malicious Intent”. De Mustang uit 1966 wordt geschuurd om hem klaar te maken voor de spuitcabine. De Camaro uit ’86 wordt onder de motorkap omgebouwd tot een Sniper System.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "1975 Corvette"
programme.desc: Vinnie werkt aan het vervangen van de meters in een Corvette uit 1975. De dorpels van de Corvette uit 1964 zijn klaar om teruggeplaatst te worden.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Dirt Vs Road"
programme.desc: De Ultimate Rider moet zowel op onverharde wegen als op asfalt kunnen rijden om de eerste plaats te behalen. En verrassende eliminaties kunnen hun droom op elk moment beëindigen. Zou iemand na slechts één dag al naar huis kunnen gaan?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Queen of the Dirt"
programme.desc: Eindelijk zien we de nieuwkomers voor het eerst op de dirt track verschijnen, en het spel verandert. Wie zal de meeste punten behalen en zich profileren als degene die verslagen moet worden, en wie zal bezwijken onder de druk?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Gymkhana"
programme.desc: De rookies volgen een Start Skills-sessie onder leiding van de legendarische Daryl Beattie en keren daarna terug naar het asfalt voor een gymkhana. Wie bedwingt het lastige parcours en pakt de punten?

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Madagascar"
programme.desc: Een Canadese MTB-avonturier verkent Madagascar en geeft een kijkje achter de schermen van de processen om een film te maken.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Norway"
programme.desc: Een Ierse MTB-pro ontdekt en rijdt de mooiste routes die Noorwegen te bieden heeft, van de bergen tot de oceaan.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Alaska"
programme.desc: Wij volgen een van de beste MTB'ers en trailbouwers ter wereld tijdens een reis door Alaska, een van de meest afgelegen, ruige plaatsen ter wereld.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "The thin line to success"
programme.desc: Wij bewandelen het pad naar succes: van het levensveranderende ongeluk van Alberto Puig tot de verbazingwekkende sponsoring van de Laglisse Champions' Squad.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "So Near, So Far"
programme.desc: Wij onthullen hoe Maverich & Alvaro omgaan met de eenzaamheid die gepaard gaat met het kampioenschap: Maverick laat de steun van zijn familie los terwijl familie juist alles is voor Alvaro Bautista.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Race Against or Share With?"
programme.desc: We ontdekken de relatie tussen Brad en Darryn Binder, 2 broers die tegen elkaar racen op motorcircuits over de hele wereld.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Orange You Glad It’s K2?"
programme.desc: De Ghouls slaan de handen ineen voor een epische SEMA-bouw! Een eerbetoon aan een Dodge T/A Challenger uit 1970, in een kleur die Will nog nooit heeft gespoten: Go Mango! Oftewel Vitamine C voor alle Plymouthfans.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "The ‘Cuda has a Challenger"
programme.desc: Na jaren van opsluiting zijn de Ghoulz terug op SEMA! Maar eerst moeten ze de eerbetoon 1970 Dodge T/A Challenger afmaken. Deze prachtige custom-built is uitgerust in de onnavolgbare OEM-stijl van de Graveyard.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Is That a Freckle?"
programme.desc: Kort na de vlucht en nog steeds uitgeput van de SEMA-show in Las Vegas, gaan Mark en de Ghoulz weer aan de slag. Will bereidt zich enthousiast voor op het spuiten van zijn allereerste 1970 AAR 'Cuda.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "It is what it is.."
programme.desc: Team Indiana, de underdogs van Ultra 4, nemen het op tegen de vijand.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Blood, Sweat and Gears"
programme.desc: De racecarrière van de knappe Jay Callaway staat op het spel tijdens een van de lastigste technische races van de serie aan de oostkust.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "The Outsider"
programme.desc: Wayland Campbell en Levi Shirley gaan nek-aan-nek om de titel te pakken, maar outsider Randy Slawson, tweevoudig kampioen, mag niet onderschat worden.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie komt in een Lamborghini SVJ roadster aan in Las Vegas. Onder de vleugels van Patrick, oprichter van de Junkyard Pirates, wordt Alex meegenomen in de wereld van de rat rod: het thuis van de Amerikaanse mavericks en outsiders.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "Malicious Intent"
programme.desc: Vinnie en het team van Muscle Cars of Texas werken in de spuitcabine aan de “Malicious Intent”. De Mustang uit 1966 wordt geschuurd om hem klaar te maken voor de spuitcabine. De Camaro uit ’86 wordt onder de motorkap omgebouwd tot een Sniper System.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2 - "1975 Corvette"
programme.desc: Vinnie werkt aan het vervangen van de meters in een Corvette uit 1975. De dorpels van de Corvette uit 1964 zijn klaar om teruggeplaatst te worden.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Meet the Contestants"
programme.desc: V8 Supercar-legendes Rick en Todd Kelly hebben Australië en de rest van de wereld afgestruind op zoek naar coureurs uit alle lagen van de bevolking. Gedurende elf spannende weken zullen onze tien beginnende coureurs het tegen elkaar opnemen in een reeks sudden death-uitdagingen.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Lap Consistency"
programme.desc: Hoewel alle tien de deelnemers vorige week op het nippertje aan eliminatie ontsnapten, kregen twee van hen een waarschuwing — en voor hen begint de dreiging van uitschakeling nu echt door te dringen.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Braking Challenge"
programme.desc: Het is week drie, en de deelnemers bereiden zich voor op een nieuwe ronde uitdagingen.

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Oil and Uncertainty"
programme.desc: Met de racedag in zicht loopt de spanning hoog op. Kunnen ongeteste aanpassingen en puur doorzettingsvermogen hen tot de startlijn brengen — of zal het meedogenloze Baja-terrein hen vóór de race breken?

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Collision Course"
programme.desc: Jimmy’s laatste trainingssessies eindigen in pech en paniek, terwijl Bruce tijdens de race alles op alles zet om zijn truck onderweg aan te passen.

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Mechanical Meltdown"
programme.desc: Terwijl brandstoftekorten en mechanische storingen hun race dreigen te beëindigen, lopen de spanningen op. Zullen ze de chaos overwinnen en hun droom levend houden?

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Morgan"
programme.desc: Mats veeleisende klant Gordon is op zoek naar een Morgan, maar kan hij wel de ideale auto vinden tegen de juiste prijs?

programme.title: Find Me A Classic S1 - "Citroen DS"
programme.desc: Mat gaat op zoek naar een perfecte Citroen DS voor Leon, een man met sterke connecties met de DS en met Frankrijk.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: De eilandstaat met 7.000 eilanden heeft geen gebrek aan strand, zon of zee – maar kampt met een hardnekkig imagoprobleem als het om de keuken gaat. Jonathan landt in Manila en ontdekt al snel dat de topchefs zich maar al te goed bewust zijn van dit probleem. Op hun advies vertrekt hij op expeditie om een deel van de oplossing te vinden. De reis voert hem van dorpen van voormalige koppensnellers, via koloniale stadjes waar de tijd heeft stilgestaan, tot restaurants in de schaduw van het Amerikaanse militaire machtsblok. Gaandeweg ontvouwt zich een intrigerend verhaal. In de dichte jungle blijft het ene geheim begraven, terwijl het andere letterlijk uit het houtwerk tevoorschijn komt. Maar het gevaar is nooit ver weg… zombie-achtige murenen, aardverschuivingsgevoelige bergpassen en verboden velden achter de rijstvelden.

Maar het gevaar is nooit ver weg… zombie-achtige murenen, aardverschuivingsgevoelige bergpassen en verboden velden achter de rijstvelden.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Finland is dat ene Noordse land dat zelden op de wereldkaart van de gastronomie verschijnt. Maar terwijl niemand keek, hebben de terughoudende Finnen stilletjes hun wildplukcultuur verfijnd en verweven in een unieke keuken. Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Finland is dat ene Noordse land dat zelden op de wereldkaart van de gastronomie verschijnt. Maar terwijl niemand keek, hebben de terughoudende Finnen stilletjes hun wildplukcultuur verfijnd en verweven in een unieke keuken. Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Het is de geboorteplaats van Halloween, maar de geesten en griezels die de wereld hebben doorkruist, hebben weinig belangstelling gewekt voor de Ierse keuken. Jonathan stapt op een klassieke motor en doorkruist een land vol mystieke tradities, uitbundige locals en iconische landschappen. ’s Werelds meest onweerstaanbare pubcultuur trekt hem aan, grensconflicten drijven hem weg en duistere legendes lokken hem verder. Een avontuur doordrenkt van regen, sagen en het eten van voorouders uit vervlogen tijden.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Ruhr District"
programme.desc: Josh verkent het industriële Rurhgebied in Duitsland en ontdekt verlaten staal- en mijnfabrieken en ervaart het leven van de mijnwerker onder de grond.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Brazil…The Amazon"
programme.desc: Een jaguar in het wild zien is vrijwel onmogelijk, maar samen met een van de vooraanstaande jaguarexperts neemt Bill deel aan een prooi-roofdierstudie om zijn kansen te vergroten. Tijdens het onderzoek komt hij letterlijk oog in oog te staan met een 5,5 meter lange Amazone-anaconda.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Antarctica"
programme.desc: Woeste oceanen, gigantische ijsbergen en adembenemende landschappen zijn dagelijkse kost op het Zuidelijk Continent. Bill loopt mee met onderzoekers die tellingen uitvoeren van een van de meest fascinerende vogels ter wereld: de pinguïn.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Papua New Guinea"
programme.desc: Er is geen plek op aarde met zo’n rijke culturele diversiteit als Papoea-Nieuw-Guinea. Bill volgt het spoor van de legendarische koppensnellers diep het regenwoud in en ontdekt geheimen die nog mysterieuzer zijn.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Donsol, Philippines"
programme.desc: Rampen en triomfen maken deze reis onvergetelijk. De broers beginnen met een bijna-dodelijk bootongeluk in de zuidelijke Filippijnse Zee, maar weten zich te herstellen en bereiken uiteindelijk hun doel: het dorp Donsol, de walhaai-hoofdstad van de wereld.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering vermijden de broers de bekendere plekken zoals Tokyo en Kyoto en trekken ze naar het afgelegen, eeuwenoude eiland Shikoku. Hun route volgt de historische 88 Tempel Zen-pelgrimstocht.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Cape Breton Island, Canada"
programme.desc: Per pick-uptruck verkennen de broers het cultureel en geografisch rijke eiland Cape Breton en de beroemde Cabot Trail. Hummervissen, vishaken, elks spotten, bingo, Schotse ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq-trommelsessies – alles komt voorbij in deze aflevering.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 1"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent de epische kustwandelroutes van Gaspésie en beleeft ongelooflijke nachtwandelingen in de wildernis van de Eastern Townships in Québec.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 2"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson maakt een trektocht langs het spectaculaire Saguenayfjord, voordat hij aan een peddelavontuur in de Laurentian Mountains van Québec begint.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 3"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson trotseert de elementen tijdens een vroege sneeuwstorm in Charlevoix en jaagt daarna zijn adrenaline op met een wildwatertocht op de machtige Ottawa-rivier.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Friendship"
programme.desc: Na aankomst in Argentinië verblijft Leon bij een dakloze familie. Hij gaat bungeejumpen en ontmoet een Haïtiaanse student met een gouden hart.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Kindness"
programme.desc: Leon rijdt naar 'De bodem van de wereld'. Hij herinnert zich iedereen die hem onderweg heeft geholpen, en zal nog één bijzonder geschenk uitdelen...

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Isle of Wight"
programme.desc: Cody ervaart het 'eilandleven' op het Eiland Wight in Engeland, de ware hemel voor urban exploring, compleet met eeuwenoude vuurtoren en een verlaten vakantieresort.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Charleroi"
programme.desc: Een verkenningstocht in het industriële Charleroi brengt Cody naar verlaten fabrieken en een onbekende plek vol kleurrijke graffiti. Een oud casino wordt ontdekt.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nicosia"
programme.desc: Josh is in Cyprus voor een lokaal verkenningsavontuur op het eiland en gaat op roadtrip van Nicosia naar een verlaten attractiepark, een asbestmijn en een scheepswrak.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "South Korea"
programme.desc: Volg Bill terwijl hij een immens middeleeuws fort bezoekt dat doet denken aan de Verboden Stad. Van reusachtige grafheuvels en nieuwe olympische locaties tot bewegend voedsel – Bill gaat op zoek naar de ziel van dit moderne, eeuwenoude land.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Yap"
programme.desc: De meest waanzinnige duik beleeft hij echter wanneer hij tientallen haaien voert – zonder enige bescherming. In een poging dat op land te overtreffen, sluit Bill een ongelooflijke deal met een lokale stamhoofd om te filmen op een plek waar nog nooit eerder is gefilmd… Het Verboden Eiland.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Madagascar"
programme.desc: Het echte Madagaskar kent geen pratende leeuwen, zebra’s of nijlpaarden. Wat het wél heeft, is de meest unieke verzameling planten en dieren op aarde. Bill trotseert het nauwelijks toegankelijke terrein om een zeldzame dansende lemuur te vinden – en een andere die zingt.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Volcan Madera, Nicaragua"
programme.desc: De broers bereiken hun doel door op motorfietsen naar het hart van Nicaragua te rijden. Ze doorkruisen de jungle naar afgelegen stranden aan de Pacifische kust en reizen landinwaarts door Spaanse koloniale steden, lokale dorpen en het immense vulkanische eiland Ometepe.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Yorkshire Dales, England"
programme.desc: Stel je een kroegentocht voor langs 26 pubs, verspreid over 7 dagen en 60 mijl! Tijdens een traditionele ramble door de adembenemende Yorkshire Dales in Noord-Engeland trekken de broers door heidevelden, dalen, pieken en valleien – met benen én lever nog intact.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Erg Chigagga, Sahara, Morocco"
programme.desc: Vanuit Marrakesh nemen de broers een reeks lokale Berber-taxi’s over het High Atlasgebergte en dalen af in de Draa-vallei, totdat de weg eindigt aan de rand van de eindeloze zandzee van de Sahara, waar ze een verborgen schat begraven.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent de prachtige wandelroutes rond Mount Taranaki en Mount Hikurangi op het Noordereiland van Nieuw-Zeeland.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Valley of Desolation"
programme.desc: Xander en z'n team bezoeken Graaff-Reinet, één van de oudste steden in Zuid-Afrika, om de cuisine, geschiedenis en natuur te ervaren. Adam verdoet zijn tijd met het zoeken naar fossielen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Dullstroom Highlands"
programme.desc: Xander en zijn team rijden elf uur lang naar Dullstroom, een pittoresk stadje waar vissen en drank de boventoon voert. Door een beetje mee te kunnen doen, vindt Adam iets interessants in de supermarkt.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Panorama"
programme.desc: Aan weerszijden van de wereld proberen Adam en een lid van de Zuid-Afrikaanse crew hun angsten te overwinnen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Love"
programme.desc: Met een gratis tank vol benzine, gegeven door een reiziger, verlaten Leon en zijn motorfiets Kindness One® de stad LA. In Sin City spelen ze letterlijk met hun geluk, voordat ze hulp vinden van een Schot in een afgelegen Westernstadje in Colorado. Deze ontmoeting inspireert hem voor zijn eerste verrassingsgeschenk.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Security"
programme.desc: Leon ervaart het boerenleven op een veeboerderij in Nebraska. Hij heeft motorproblemen in Chicago, en wordt genegeerd door de Amish. Maar een toevallige ontmoeting met een dakloze man in Pittsburgh werkt inspirerend, en helpt hem om zijn volgende geschenk te vinden.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Inspiration"
programme.desc: Leon vindt onderdak in de gevaarlijkste stad ter wereld, en baant zich een weg over de Atlantische Oceaan aan boord van een vrachtschip. Een Spaanse douaneprobleem dreigt zijn reis te doen ontsporen, maar de muziek van twee Afrikaanse muzikanten in Zuid-Frankrijk inspireren zijn volgende geschenk.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Mongolia"
programme.desc: Niets op aarde is te vergelijken met Mongolië. Hier trekken de laatste nomadische volkeren met hun vee over miljoenen hectaren grasland. Bill drinkt gefermenteerde merriemelk (volgens hem het smerigste drankje ooit), rijdt op een jak en spoort het oorspronkelijke wilde paard op.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "North Pole"
programme.desc: Het team vaart met een ijsbreker naar de Noordpool, net op tijd om Bill’s moeder via een satelliettelefoon te bellen en haar een gelukkige verjaardag te wensen (ze is zo verbaasd dat ze hem niet herkent). Ondertussen volgen en filmen ze de grootste roofdieren op aarde… ijsberen.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Rwanda…Gorillas"
programme.desc: Bill trekt door eindeloze modder, dichte vegetatie en steile bergen om oog in oog te staan met onze machtige verwanten – de gorilla’s. Hij volgt ook het leven en ontdekt de restanten van het kamp van een van zijn helden: Dian Fossey.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Arviat, Nunavut, Canada"
programme.desc: Op weg naar het uiterste noorden, naar de Arctis, om de traditionele cultuur en het indrukwekkende leven van de Inuit te ontdekken, vergezellen de broers een oudere en een jonge jager op een 200 mijl lange sneeuwscootertocht over het barre land en bevroren zee-ijs.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Banff & Lake Louise"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson gaat heli-hiken en verkent grotten terwijl hij Canada’s eerste en meest populaire nationale park en het naburige Lake Louise ontdekt.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Australia’s Northern Territory"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Australië om de Larapinta Trail en het Kakadu National Park te verkennen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Into the Bush"
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn crew de bush intrekken, ontdekken ze de mooiste aspecten van Zuid-Afrika: nationale parken, safari's en wilde dieren.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Lowveldt"
programme.desc: Terwijl Adam vecht tegen een golf van droefenis, beleven Xander en zijn team een Afrikaanse safari te paard, waarbij ze spectaculaire wilde dieren en adembenemende savannes bewonderen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Transformation"
programme.desc: Nadat hij in St. Tropez is verdwaald op het Italiaanse platteland, vindt Leon onderdak in een 18e-eeuwse villa buiten Turijn. Maar zijn geluk raakt op aan de oevers van het Comomeer.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Abundance"
programme.desc: Na gesurft te hebben in Zagreb, en nadat Leon de turbulente geschiedenis van Sarajevo heeft leren kennen, gaan hij op de Kindness One® naar Montenegro. Daar ontmoet hij een vriendelijke boer, wiens familie al 20 generaties lang hetzelfde land bewerkt. Dit inspireert hem tot zijn volgende verrassingscadeau.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Botswana is een droom voor natuurliefhebbers, met enorme kuddes olifanten, reusachtige groepen nijlpaarden en enkele van de grootste leeuwentroepen ter wereld. Het is ook de thuisbasis van de Victoriawatervallen – de grootste waterval ter wereld.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "New Zealand & Australia"
programme.desc: Bill is altijd al gefascineerd geweest door de America's Cup-zeilrace – en die is net zo intens als de naam doet vermoeden. Maar het echte avontuur beleeft hij in een Sovjet Mig-jet: hij vliegt mee, voert stunts uit en maakt zenuwslopende laagvliegers mee.

programme.desc: Anthony flies the 206 from Canada to the United States and checks in with Customs.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sight"
programme.desc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. People with good vision are sometimes called "eagle eyed", but eagles can see a fish from many dozen metres away.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Hearing"
programme.desc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Touch"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Taste and Smell"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Superhuman Senses"
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sense of Timing"
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programme.desc: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground…

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Night"
programme.desc: We find out about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive. Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason. You need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"
programme.desc: We find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground. And find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Communication"
programme.desc: Animals use communication to attract mates,warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey. And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"
programme.desc: In this last episode of Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Emergency Bridges/Marker Pens/Electric superbike"
programme.desc: How do they build emergency bridges that can take the weight of a tank? How do they make a marker pen that never fades? How do they design a 200 mph superbike?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Crystal Glass/Flat Screen TVs/Deepest Pool/Ketchup"
programme.desc: How do they blow the world’s finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world’s slimmest TVs? How do they heat the world’s deepest swimming pool? How do they fill a million bottles a day of the world’s favourite ketchup?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Pulverizer/Bomber Jackets/Lambic Beer/"
programme.desc: How do they forge a set of jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks? How do they stitch the historic airman’s bomber? How do they brew the oldest beer in the Western World?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Sydney Opera House/Handsaws/Microphones/Icebreaker"
programme.desc: How do they cool Sydney’s famous Opera House? How do they turn Sheffield steel into a carpenter’s handsaw? How do they make a microphone that can pick up a whisper? How do they steer a safe course through a frozen river?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Moonshine/e-bikes/Wetsuits"
programme.desc: How do they brew moonshine in the heart of New York City? How do they make a battery powered bicycle that can do nearly 30mph? How do they grow the rubber for wetsuits in the Arizona desert?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry Down Under"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry start off the new season testing one of the most requested films, Quigley Down Under. Terry will see if he can hit a 564-yard shot with a Sharps rifle. An 800-yard shot, trying to kill 2 bad guys with 1 bullet!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Bond, Terry Bond"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will be testing the effectiveness of driving a vehicle with fully automatic machine guns mounted to the car! Just like 007 did with his Aston Martin DB5.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Just-Terry-Fied"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will be test 2 scenes from Justified where, Terry, aka Raylan Givins finds himself in a bathtub and a dead body lying over top of him.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Reindeer Game"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test a scene from Reindeer Games when Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron get trapped under a frozen lake, and they escape by shooting 3 shots with a 12-gauge shot gun underwater to blast a hole in the ice to escape.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Deadliest Weapons"
programme.desc: As the battle distance continued to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millenia to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Navigating The Globe"
programme.desc: This episode dives into the pioneering breakthroughs from across the globe that have shaped our ability to travel.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Tools & Tech"
programme.desc: Delve into the history of technology; from a simple rock to the invention of modern computing.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Anatomy of the House"
programme.desc: From living in caves to grand mansions, shelter has always been high on the list of our priorities. Bur form and function varies wildly throughout civilizations.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "MMA - Nick Hein"
programme.desc: Nick Hein is a professional Mixed Martial Artist from Cologne and signed with the UFC. His ultimate goal is to become MMA world champion.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Extreme Martial Arts – Shaina West"
programme.desc: Shaina West taught herself martial arts by watching Youtube recovering from a motorcycle accident. The videos she posted went viral and ‘The Samurider’ was born.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Karate – James Pankiewicz"
programme.desc: Englishman and karateka James Pankiewicz came to Okinawa, the birthplace of Karate, for his wife and to open a Dojo and the immensely popular Dojo Bar.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Bokator – Tharot Sam"
programme.desc: Tharoth Sam, 26, is the first female fighter in Cambodian Bokator. She is also an MMA fighter and became a movie star starring in the big screen blockbuster, Jailbreak.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "The Humanoid Robots"
programme.desc: They look, they move like us and soon they will live among us. They are humanoid robots.Meet an astonishing group of humanoids,among them: iCub,the world's first baby robot and REEM,the Service Robot,ready to be launched as a guide in public spaces.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Bioinspired Robots"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at a robotic plant that mimics the mechanics of plant roots, and dive underwater to see robots inspired by fish.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "City of the Future"
programme.desc: By the year 2050, three qarters of the world's population will live in urban areas. Looking at robotic systems being developed worlwide we can take a glimpse at the city life of the future.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Robot Explorers"
programme.desc: Inhospitable environments that would normally be unreacheble become accessible thanks to Robot Explorers. Robots can help us in difficult tasks but is there any danger in letting machines handle so many tasks that used to belong to us?

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Home to more than 37 million people, Greater Tokyo is the largest city in the world. To say it’s crowded is nothing short of an understatement. Join us as we navigate this gargantuan yet liveable city that still manages to function on a human scale.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Sydney"
programme.desc: Sydney is a city defined by its harbour: the sapphire jewel in Australia’s crown. Established as a penal colony in 1788, it remains a city of immigrants’ intent on “bending the rules”. It’s brash, it’s crass and it’s full of engineering marvels.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Naples"
programme.desc: Naples is one of Europe’s oldest and most beautifully situated cities; a matrimonio of culture and nature, staring down the ravages of time. Few urban societies remain as closely connected to their past, which is proving both a blessing and a curse.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Seattle"
programme.desc: Innovation underscores this episode, set in one of the fastest growing cities in America. Ever on the cusp of discovering the “next big thing”, Seattle is where Amazon, Microsoft, Google are forging the future.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Memory"
programme.desc: Jack meets the world memory champion and a man who can remember every day of his life.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programme.sub-title: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
programme.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.sub-title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programme.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programme.sub-title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programme.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S2 - "Phillippines"
programme.desc: Bruce Crompton is back! Follow the fortunes of bruce and his specialist team as they buy, restore and sell WW2 military vehicles and memorabilia.

programme.title: Combat Dealers S2 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Bruce and Hus head to freezing Finland following a hot tip. Up near the Arctic Circle there's a kind of Winder Wonderland of World War Two vehicles and equipment.

programme.title: Grizzly Encounters with Chris Morgan

programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.desc: Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.desc: The captives of an "inescapable" Nazi POW camp hatch the most daring escape plan of all time.

programme.title: Platoon

programme.desc: Christian Bale delivers a powerful performance as pilot Dieter Dengler, a prisoner in the Vietnam war.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.

programme.title: Capote

programme.title: Thunderbolt And Lightfoot
programme.desc: A former thief and a brash young drifter team up to pull off the perfect heist in this bold crime thriller!

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Experience the greatest love story ever told in the most acclaimed movie musical of all time!

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Shirley MacLaine are delightful in this tale of love and ambition.

programme.title: Irma La Douce
programme.desc: Billy Wilder's bawdy, charming and romantic farce about a French policeman who falls in love with a prostitute

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: This comedy gem introduces Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case!

programme.title: A Shot In The Dark (1964)
programme.desc: Bumbling Inspector Clouseau must find a high-profile culprit quickly, or his career will be finit!

programme.title: Mermaids
programme.desc: Cher, Winona Ryder, and Christina Ricci shine as an unpredictable mother and her two quirky daughters.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Inspired by Oliver Stone's own experiences, this anti-war epic tells the tale of PFC Chris Taylor (Charlie Sheen), an Army recruit sent to Vietnam, who witnesses the atrocities of war – many of which are carried out by his comrades.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Into The Blue 2: The Reef
programme.desc: Sebastion and Dani, owners of a small diving company in Hawaii, are excited when hired by jet-setters offering big money for help in finding a sunken treasure. But the young pair soon find that the job will test their diving – and survival - skills!

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: Good Guys Wear Black
programme.desc: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell, "The Passage") controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty, "Cadillac Man") and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threatens to kill hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal in this comedy thriller that asks the question, "How come the bad guys always drive the good cars?"

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.
